Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane of a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when the vehicle moved into
the adjacent lane and made contact with the side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 rpeorted a concussion
and was eavluated at the scene. Responding officers confirmed that a Passenger was also present in Driver 1's
vehicle at the time of the collision. Statements from two independent witnesses, the photographs taken at the scene,
and Driver 2's account all agree with the sequence of events Driver 1 described. The damage visible on both
vehicles, including scraping and displaced panels along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the matching marks on
Driver 2's left side, is consistent with a sideswipe impact of this kind. Driver 1 told the officer there was no prior
damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was observed or recorded during the investigation. Driver 1 is listed as
a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The reported head injury is consistent with the froces expected in
a collision of this type. Officers issued no citations at the scene pending review of the collected evidence.
